benchmark_evidence.observed: Explicit sharing of private drafts, inbox/conversation-based access, single-editor takeover and live editing visibility are documented. Foundly does not yet claim live co-editing or inbox access equivalence.

The documented draft-reply API uses drafts write scope and explicit conversation/channel references, private/shared modes, recipient lists and bounded attachments. This is benchmark evidence, not a Foundly implementation claim.

capabilities.foundly_current: Owned drafts, templates, threads and preferences remain standalone. Draft sharing uses explicit owner/admin authority, a bounded tenant member search, current member status and current parent ACL for all retained revisions. Edits use revision preconditions. Restore creates a new draft revision, preserves current collaborators, binds idempotency to the actor/input and does not send. History survives encrypted restart and persistence failure rolls back draft, history, audit and receipt together. Legacy unversioned drafts retain a labelled baseline. Dashboard separates drafts from retained messages and treats unavailable, invalid or incomplete source contracts as unavailable.
capabilities.gap: Live co-editing/takeover, comments, attachments, reply/forward and complete inbox workflows remain incomplete; actual browser/keyboard/viewport acceptance is blocked.
capabilities.required_change: Complete source-bound message/thread preparation, safe attachment handling and inbox workflows, then verify real browser and authorized provider behavior.
capabilities.foundly_differentiator: Candidate: shared Core identity, provenance and ZERO tools. Comparative superiority is not proven.
